## Context
This is a log of fixes to bring [alineR](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/alineR/index.html) back to CRAN. Last check from CRAN is [here](http://cran-archive.r-project.org/web/checks/2021/2021-04-21_check_results_alineR.html).

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
